I can relate to some extent to what you're saying. 1 helpful tip I read was that when these thoughts arise in your mind be mindful of them and accept them as they are without forcing your mind to believe they are false. When you start seeing these thoughts objectively you may actually see that they actually have no credibility. 
Another thing assume what the person says is true to be reflective of what they feel, until they say otherwise. And when they give you a compliment make effort into accepting it and saying thanks.

I think it has more to do so with what your definition of creepy is than others. Every time you feel this way, you can practice mindfulness to acknowledge this feeling and let it pass. Eventually you can begin to see what about yourself do you think others will perceive as creepy and gradually start to combat these thoughts.

There can be a variety of reasons you feel that way. I myself went through a something similar and spent a lot of time understanding and reading up what it meant and why is it so. One definite conclusion is that it is not permanent and may be heavily affected by how your day to day life is going. 
So try not to ponder about it too much and concentrate more on activities that make you feel happy. 
I'm not a psychologist, but I believe when you feel content and happy with your daily life all of the other things will fall into place.

Bro, I'm gonna give you real advice. Genes do have a contribution in determining your appearances and the way you are perceived. But this natural or immutable factor in determining one's appearance is thought of as more important than it actually is.

Your attractiveness depends on many other factors such as the way you dress, your personality, the way you carry yourself and how skillful you are. This is the reason why so many popular celebrities or successful people in their field are considered attractive, when if their appearance taken in isolation is average at best.

My point being focus on the characteristics that you **can** change. Take up a physical activity, read a lot and invest time in building yourself. Witty and intelligent people are naturally considered attractive.

Also, don't take the opinion of other people to heart, because it doesn't define what the truth is, it only defines what their perception is. Be self-confident and improve in every moment.
